references.text: The preceding verse that begins the counting of fifty days from the day after the Sabbath
Parallel command regarding the Feast of Weeks (Shavuot) with the counting of seven weeks and celebration with a voluntary offering
The Feast of Weeks mentioned as the Feast of Firstfruits at the wheat harvest
The Day of Firstfruits (Feast of Weeks) with the presentation of a new grain offering to the Lord
The fulfillment of Pentecost (the fiftieth day) when the Holy Spirit was poured out on the disciples
Paul wishes to be in Jerusalem on Pentecost, which is the fiftieth day after Passover
Paul mentions Pentecost as an important feast he wants to celebrate in Ephesus
